title: Weighted blow-up at a point of a Lusin piece with vanishing excess densities
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, Hⁿ := μHE[n], let a = (M, θ) be an admissible pair (RectifiablePair n ℓ) with weight μ := (mk a).weight, let N ⊆ E be Borel with Hⁿ(N) < ∞, K ⊆ E compact with K ⊆ M ∩ N, x ∈ K a point at which θ restricted to K is continuous (ContinuousWithinAt θ K x), f ∈ C_c(E, ℝ), and Γ, L ∈ ℝ. Assume (H1) Hⁿ(N ∩ B_ρ(x)) ≤ ofReal(Γρⁿ) for every ρ > 0; (H2) μ(Kᶜ ∩ B_r(x))/rⁿ → 0 as r ↓ 0; (H3) (Hⁿ⌞N)(Kᶜ ∩ B_r(x))/rⁿ → 0 as r ↓ 0; (H4) (tⁿ)⁻¹∫_N f(t⁻¹(y − x)) dHⁿ(y) → L as t ↓ 0. (B_r(x) is the closed ball, Kᶜ = E ∖ K, and the measures in (H2), (H3) are taken as real numbers via toReal.) Then (tⁿ)⁻¹∫ f(t⁻¹(y − x)) dμ(y) → θ(x)·L as t ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ) (N K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ)) (Γ L : ℝ), MeasurableSet N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) N ≠ ⊤ → IsCompact K → K ⊆ a.M ∩ N → x ∈ K → ContinuousWithinAt a.θ K x → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (N ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (mk a).weight.real (Kᶜ ∩ closedBall x r) / r ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict N).real (Kᶜ ∩ closedBall x r) / r ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y in N, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂(mk a).weight) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (a.θ x * L))
